newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Little Swan '96 net hits 178 mln yua.
newsitem.headline: Little Swan '96 net hits 178 mln yua.

text.p: Chinese washing machine maker Wuxi Little Swan Co Ltd had net profits of 178.48 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
Earnings per share were 0.7307 yuan and turnover reached 1.35 billion yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 147.19 million yuan on turnover of 1.01 billion yuan under Chinese standards.
The company proposed a cash dividend of 5.10 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in Little Swan's A and B shares will be suspended on Monday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
